name: apimachinery-first-class-api-identity-aliases
instr:
Kubernetes apimachinery cannot resolve directed GVK and GVR compatibility aliases to one canonical API identity across schema, runtime, serialization, and REST mapping. Add first-class aliases that preserve requested identity as provenance. Creation, decoding, and endpoint selection must use the canonical type. Undeclared aliases leave behavior unchanged.

Normalization is transitive, deterministic, declaration-order independent, and leaves unknown identities unchanged. `Scheme.AddKnownTypeAlias` and `Scheme.ResolveTypeAlias` create and recognize the canonical registered type without disturbing ObjectKinds ordering. Cycles, conflicting targets, and unknown canonical types fail atomically with inspectable `AliasError` results.

Negotiated decoding retains wire provenance. Ordinary encoding uses the canonical identity; only explicit alias version selection emits the alias. Conversion and parameter behavior stay compatible. `DefaultRESTMapper.AddIdentityAlias` and `RESTMapping.AliasResolution` expose requested identities while resolving canonical endpoints and scope.

`PriorityRESTMapper.ResolveIdentityAlias`, `ResolveIdentityAlias`, and `ResolveIdentityAliasWithContext` canonicalize before prioritizing and preserve stable candidate order. A `meta.MultiRESTMapper` built from `RESTMapper` delegates uses `MultiRESTMapper.ResolveIdentityAlias` to merge results with a canonical alias target. It returns `AliasConflictError` when equivalent requests resolve to materially different map
